name: Complete or update 'Service Health Check App' (SHCA)
source: Related to standards but not under a standard
conditionsText:
For 'genuine' services (ones that DfE create to deliver things): 
- transactional 
- has users 
- an interface
requirementTitle: Complete or update 'Service Health Check App' (SHCA)
requirementDescription: A tool to declare compliance to DfE standards and policies on a yearly basis.
why: This came out of audit in April 2023 which found DfE doesn't have a mechanism to view the compliance landscape of their services and for teams to declare compliance. SHCA aims to do this. The standards in it are based on things established in the Standards Forum.
tasks: Once a service gets a service offering, it will get pulled into SHCA
Steve looks at what has been registered on CMDB in the last 7 days
Steve chases people to complete it (if they haven't already)
Delivery team goes on SHCA intranet page to find link and guidance
standards: Related to standards but not under a standard
guidance: Intranet page for Service Health Check Hub
